notes: Identity assessment: supplied source opens with Personality Change Following Unemployment and Christopher J. Boyce, Alex M. Wood, Michael Daly, and Constantine Sedikides. The DOI is not printed in the supplied text, so DOI identity cannot be independently confirmed from this file alone. Source URL names a Stirling repository PDF. Full manuscript text includes methods, results, references and Table 5. No PDF path was supplied; no acquisition or rendering performed. Table 5 appears on manuscript pp. 53–54 rather than locator p.12. Target matched by trait column, explicit linear/quadratic predictor label, and mean-level change (slope) outcome. Main duration term is distinguished from the separately labeled Female interaction. The source codes female 0 = male, 1 = female.
